reviews.title: Kasa now had ADS
reviews.text:
Imagine my shock this afternoon.  I arrived home and opened the Kasa App to turn off my security camera and was greeted with a BIG FAT ADVERTISEMENT!!!
Wasn’t it enough that I spent extra money to purchase products that used the Kasa App, but now you’ve interrupted my use with a friggin advertisement.  I will start looking for another app to control my home products because this is unacceptable.

reviews.title: Live camera feeds are terrible
reviews.text: The app is great when it works, and you can easily control all of your smart devices and customize to your needs. HOWEVER. The camera feeds have been absolutely atrocious for at least the past two weeks. The live feeds buffer *constantly*, completely defeating the point of watching live footage. Even the recorded 24/7 footage takes forever to buffer when you’re scrolling through. My wi-fi connection is perfectly fine, and nothing has changed on my end except for the intense internal suffering I’m experiencing by the insanely poor performance of the app. It’s been almost unusable, and the new update didn’t appear to even touch the issue. Definitely considering other options at this point and very frustrated. (Oh, and the forced in-app prime day ads were super annoying. Yuck.) Kasa, do better.

reviews.title: Advertisement on control screen
reviews.text:
First the ad was added recently on device control part of app where there was no ad before; advertisement should be removed. 
Second, the GUI loads slightly faster than the ad. And when you try to use a button to control something, the ad loads in the middle 15% of screen, changing button locations. That causes extra time waiting for ad to load or pressing the wrong button and fixing it.

/e: forgot I wrote a review years ago and came here to say most of the exact same things. This just goes to show almost nothing has changed - except some ux changes which have made the app even worse. I have sent in a host of bug reports over the years but I think the 3 people they have working on this just don't have any incentive to improve it at all because it's only gotten worse. Menus are harder to find, interface is harder to use, widgets get more and more broken, even core features like custom effects are riddled with bugs like broken brightness and animation speeds. These are fundamental functions of the Kasa product line. It's inexcusable how broken and bad they are for so many years Unreliable connections. Terrible ui. Unresponsive interface. Often doesn’t report correct status. It’s really just loaded with problems, and amazingly, the ux design has only gotten worse as they’ve removed shortcuts and gestures.

reviews.title: Latest update has made “Scenes” not work correctly
reviews.text: The latest update has broken the ability for scenes to toggle devices on or off.  They will toggle on correctly, but they will not toggle off. This is quite dangerous, especially if someone has a high amperage / wattage device like an electric fire or heater connected to a Kasa Smart Plug. Please fix ASAP as this latest update could be the cause of some of your customers getting killed. Just for the record - Scenes that switch ON work, Scenes that switch OFF work Scenes that toggle between ON/OFF only toggle ON but not OFF.
